title.zh: 计数、组合数学与有限概率

lead.en: Count possibilities by modelling what makes outcomes distinct. Derive selection formulas, handle overlap and repeated objects, and calculate finite probabilities only after declaring the sampling rule.
lead.zh: 根据结果的区别建立计数模型。推导选择公式，处理重叠与重复对象，并在明确抽样规则之后计算有限概率。

prerequisites.en: Modules 03–04: finite sets, products, bijections, proof by cases, and induction. Explain why a representation can overcount the same outcome. Labs require basic Python and no packages.
prerequisites.zh: 模块 03–04：有限集合、积、双射、分类证明与归纳。解释同一结果为何可能被多种表示重复计数。实验需基础 Python，无需包。

en: Choose addition or multiplication rules and state disjointness or branch assumptions.
Derive permutation and combination counts for distinct and repeated objects.
Use stars and bars only when its distinguishability and constraint assumptions hold.
Apply inclusion–exclusion, complementary counting, and the pigeonhole principle.
Compute exact finite probabilities under a declared uniform model and distinguish chance from guarantee.
zh: 选择加法或乘法规则，明确不交与分支假设。
推导不同及重复对象的排列组合数。
依据可区别性与约束正确使用隔板法。
应用容斥、补集计数与抽屉原理。
在明确均匀模型下计算有限概率，区分概率与保证。

text.en: Read Sections 1–2 and draw the small choice trees.
text.zh: 阅读第 1–2 节并画小型选择树。

text.en: Enumerate selections and compare their formulas.
Retrieve order, repetition, and disjoint-case assumptions.
text.zh: 回忆顺序、重复与不交假设。

text.en: Read Sections 3–4 and use the selection explorer.
text.zh: 阅读第 3–4 节并使用选择探索器。

text.en: Diagnose repeated-label overcounting and unequal probabilities.
text.zh: 诊断重复标签计数与不等概率。
证明练习 5 的帕斯卡恒等式。

text.en: Read the counting-rule and combination selection.
text.zh: 阅读计数规则与组合选段。

text.en: Read Section 5 and identify overlapping cases.
text.zh: 阅读第 5 节并找重叠情况。

text.en: Read inclusion–exclusion and finite probability assumptions.
text.zh: 阅读容斥与有限概率假设。

text.en: Explain why the pigeonhole guarantee differs from a probability.
text.zh: 解释抽屉保证为何不同于概率。

title.zh: 精确不确定性与故障诊断

text.en: Read Section 6 and the modelling failures.
text.zh: 阅读第 6 节与建模失败。

text.en: Compare exact collision probability with the fixed-seed simulation.
text.zh: 比较精确碰撞概率与固定种子模拟。

text.en: Complete choices, written response, and exit check.
text.zh: 完成选择、书面回答与结业检查。
